The '''press plate''' was a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] component. It was located above the trigger and below the [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating blaster module]]. The press plate had a connector known as an impulse slot which the [[trigger cable]] was plugged into.<ref name="CRFG" />
